episodes.title: La steppa batterica di Plutone
episodes.summary: Zero, a comics writer and artist who imagines his conscience as an armadillo, remembers how he first met his friend, Alice, when they were 17 years old.

episodes.title: Come un filo d'erba
episodes.summary: Zero recalls when, at 11 years old, he was briefly the teacher's pet. While on the way to pick up Secco, Zero has trouble changing a flat tire.

episodes.title: Lavorare in cantiere è peggio
episodes.summary: Zero describes his nightmarish experience tutoring kids. While waiting for Secco, Zero tells Sarah why he's so obsessed with being punctual.

episodes.title: Bussole rotte
episodes.summary: While on the train to Biella, Zero recollects what it was like struggling to look for work and explains, in detail, his apartment's various "domains."

episodes.title: Don't Ask, Don't Tell
episodes.summary: Admitting he's bad at giving emotional support, Zero remembers consoling Alice after a breakup. An encounter with a former student rattles Zero.

episodes.title: Catarsi
episodes.summary: In Biella, Zero struggles with how to grieve as Sarah blasts him for making it about him. Later, he learns of a shocking secret that sends him reeling.
